measured.horizon_source: cloud-deck motion direction (image_track.csv cloud_dx, cloud_dy, x corrected for pixel aspect 1.05), 15-frame running median; frames moving at least 1 px/frame

method: Read-only use of solve/: loads each case through solve.case_data.load_case, rebuilds every stored fit's prediction with solve.score.predict (the scorer's own forward model, at the parameters stored in data/derived/<case>/results.json) and fits the rotation terms with solve.score.rotation_terms. Nothing here re-fits a hypothesis or changes a number the scorer reports; it only evaluates the stored fits on every frame so the browser can draw them.

data.readout_horizon_note: Image horizon from the readout angles (whole degrees) and the measured bank, jet pitch 4.2 deg (case default); no hypothesis.
